GLARE_POLICY: suppress on matte surfaces; allow narrow knife‑edge specular only aligned to key
ACCENT_PALETTE: mango orange, dragonfruit magenta, lime green
TRANSLUCENCY_POLICY: fruit slices show 1–2 mm edge glow from subsurface scattering; centers stay opaque at listed thickness; no see‑through transparency; seams/grain must not be visible through fruit; coconut/textiles fully opaque; minimal color bleed
SCATTER_OCCLUSION_POLICY: coconut flakes partly overlap fruit edges and seams; some half‑overlapping; never uniform halos
ALLOWED_OBJECTS: board, fruit, knife, linen, palm leaf
FORBIDDEN_OBJECTS: abstract shapes, frames, borders, overlays, circles, rings
PLACEMENT_RULES: props around perimeter; center empty; do not draw any circle/ring/outline anywhere; no centered seams; objects must occlude seams beneath; no painted blobs
REFLECTION_STRENGTH: very low overall (matte wood); knife‑edge only
SPECULAR_BAND: narrow along knife blade only; no bars across frame
